tasks.title: Corpus Hardening — replace 6 stubs, add missing types, fix CMYK, 14 deterministic QPDF PDFs
tasks.description: Replace stubs in tests/test_corpus_generator.h/.cpp with real QPDF implementations for 14 AC3 types, fix cmyk_image to FlateDecode, ensure deterministic Helvetica Type1, TMPDIR storage, and generateAll emits exactly 14.
acceptance_criteria: Given TestCorpusGenerator header exists, When header is inspected, Then it declares generateLineArt(), generateTransparency(), generateEncrypted(), generatePhotoHeavy() (or photo_heavy alias), generateMergedDuplicateFonts() (or shared XObject alias) plus the 6 stub replacements generateWithForm/generateWithMetadata/generateWithJavaScript/generateMultiImage/generateSharedXObject/generateLargeUncompressed with consistent signatures and corpusDir() still returns $TMPDIR/pdfcompress_test_corpus.

Given generateAll is invoked, When ls $TMPDIR/pdfcompress_test_corpus/*.pdf | wc -l is run, Then count equals 14 and filenames are text_only, photo_jpeg, photo_heavy, screenshot_flat, line_art, grayscale_scan, monochrome_bw, with_form, with_bookmarks_and_links, with_javascript, with_metadata, encrypted, cmyk_image, transparency (RG-001: transparency embeds SMask + shared XObject, no separate merged_duplicate_fonts.pdf unless explicitly documented as 15th).

Given a fresh TMPDIR, When ./build/generate_corpus is run twice, Then both runs print 'Corpus generated at: ".../pdfcompress_test_corpus"', create the directory via std::filesystem::create_directories, overwrite deterministically, and every PDF passes QPDF().processFile(path) without warnings.

Given each generator, When QPDFWriter is used, Then writer.setDeterministicID(true) is called, content uses fixed dimensions and fixed pixel buffers, Type1 Helvetica /Helvetica via QPDF::emptyPDF() + QPDFObjectHandle::parse/newStream, no embedded third-party font/image, and no random IDs.
Given with_form.pdf, When inspected with QPDF or qpdf --json, Then trailer/page tree contains /AcroForm with /Fields and at least one Widget /Annot /Subtype /Widget.

Given with_metadata.pdf, When inspected, Then it contains /Info dict with /Producer or /Title and a /Metadata XMP stream plus /PieceInfo or /Thumb handling, exercising PDFOptimizer metadata strip path.
Given with_javascript.pdf, When inspected, Then it contains /Names << /JavaScript ... >> and /OpenAction << /S /JavaScript /JS (...) >> as separate type from bookmarks/links.
Given with_bookmarks_and_links.pdf, When inspected, Then it contains /Outlines /Count >=1, /Annots with /Subtype /Link or /Text, and /Dests on the catalog.

Given transparency.pdf (RG-001), When inspected, Then it contains an image XObject with /SMask << /S /Alpha >> or /SMask reference AND /Group << /S /Transparency >> on a page or XObject AND two pages share the same indirect XObject via identical QPDFObjectHandle (same object ID) to cover merged_duplicate_fonts.

Given cmyk_image.pdf, When inspected, Then it contains /ColorSpace /DeviceCMYK, /BitsPerComponent 8, /Filter /FlateDecode (not /DCTDecode), with valid compressed bytes via compress() that decompress correctly, and PDFOptimizer later reports imagesSkipped==1 for CMYK.

Given line_art.pdf, When generated, Then it is 300x300 DeviceRGB FlateDecode with high edge-density quadrants (at least 2 distinct colors in limited palette, verified by pixel buffer pattern in source) and photo_heavy.pdf is multi-page with 3 distinct images 300x200, 200x150, 250x180 each with distinct pixel content.

Given large_uncompressed.pdf, When generated, Then its uncompressed stream size is >=50KB before writer recompressFlate (e.g., 300x400*3 bytes) so that benchmark size guard is meaningful and file size on disk after writer is >=50KB or at least not tiny 667 bytes.

Given encrypted.pdf, When generated, Then QPDFWriter uses R6 AES-128 setR6Encryption (fallback setR3Encryption) with user password 'test123' no owner password, and without password QPDF::processFile throws or isEncrypted==true, while with password 'test123' it decrypts.

tasks.title: Benchmark Hardening — valid QPDF, 5-tool matrix, guarded SKIPPED, ms timing, TSV idempotency
tasks.description: Fix benchmark/run_benchmark.sh to use valid qpdf recompress invocation, add gs ebook/screen and ocrmypdf with command -v guards, ms wall timing, TSV header with SSIM/PSNR, idempotency filters, never overwrite input, || true for encrypted, dual TSV write.
acceptance_criteria: Given benchmark/run_benchmark.sh, When inspected, Then it starts with 'set -euo pipefail', takes BUILD_DIR arg default 'build', checks [ -d "$BUILD_DIR" ], regenerates corpus via (cd "$BUILD_DIR" && ./generate_corpus) | tee corpus_info.txt and parses CORPUS_DIR via grep -F 'Corpus generated at:' | awk -F'"' '{print $2}' with fallback.

Given qpdf tool row, When script runs, Then it invokes 'qpdf --recompress --compression-level=9 --object-streams=generate "$pdf" "$out"' (not --optimize) and this command is guarded by command -v qpdf; missing qpdf does not produce FAILED row.

Given Ghostscript rows, When script runs, Then it invokes 'gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dPDFSETTINGS=/ebook -dCompatibilityLevel=1.7 -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sOutputFile=' and same with /screen, each guarded by command -v gs, missing gs yields SKIPPED (not installed) row.
Given ocrmypdf row, When script runs, Then it invokes 'ocrmypdf --optimize 3 --skip-text "$pdf" "$out"' guarded by command -v ocrmypdf, missing yields SKIPPED.

Given pdfcompress row, When script runs, Then it invokes '(cd "$BUILD_DIR" && ./run_optimize "$pdf")' wrapped with '|| true' so encrypted.pdf does not abort set -e, and output is "${pdf%.pdf}_optimized.pdf" never overwriting input.

Given timing, When run_tool executes, Then wall time is measured in milliseconds via date +%s%3N or gdate +%s%3N or fallback date +%s *1000, stored as integer ms without trailing 's', using stat -f%z / stat -c%s portably and reduction% via awk '{printf "%.2f", (1-out/orig)*100}' (bc fallback allowed).

Given TSV header, When script creates RESULTS_FILE, Then header is exactly 'File\tOriginal Size\tTool\tOutput Size\tReduction %\tTime (ms)\tSSIM\tPSNR\tStatus' with SSIM 3 decimals PSNR 1 decimal or N/A, and Status is OK/SKIPPED (not installed)/FAILED only for real failure.

Given missing tool, When tool binary not found, Then script writes one row per tool per PDF with Output Size 'SKIPPED (not installed)' and Status 'SKIPPED (not installed)' rather than FAILED, and still produces pdfcompress rows.

Given corpus dir contains *_optimized.pdf, *.qpdf.pdf, *.opt.pdf, *.gs*.pdf, *.ocrmypdf.pdf from prior run, When script iterates "$CORPUS_DIR"/*.pdf, Then it skips all patterns '*_optimized*' '*.qpdf*' '*.opt*' '*.gs*' '*.ocrmypdf*' to ensure idempotency and no re-benchmarking of outputs.

Given script completes, When ls is checked, Then benchmark_results_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.tsv exists in cwd and in build/ (copy), and script prints column -t -s $'\t' table, and never overwrites input PDFs (all outputs are <name>.<tool>.pdf alongside corpus).

Given encrypted.pdf in corpus, When run_tool runs pdfcompress on it, Then script does not exit due to set -e because of || true, and generates a FAILED or SKIPPED row with error handling but continues looping remaining PDFs.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given benchmark/run_benchmark.sh, When inspected, Then it starts with 'set -euo pipefail', takes BUILD_DIR arg default 'build', checks [ -d "$BUILD_DIR" ], regenerates corpus via (cd "$BUILD_DIR" && ./generate_corpus) | tee corpus_info.txt and parses CORPUS_DIR via grep -F 'Corpus generated at:' | awk -F'"' '{print $2}' with fallback.
tests.expected_result: head -n5 benchmark/run_benchmark.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'; grep -q 'BUILD_DIR=.*build' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh; grep -q 'generate_corpus' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh; grep -q 'Corpus generated at:' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given qpdf tool row, When script runs, Then it invokes 'qpdf --recompress --compression-level=9 --object-streams=generate "$pdf" "$out"' (not --optimize) and this command is guarded by command -v qpdf; missing qpdf does not produce FAILED row.
tests.expected_result: grep -q -- '--recompress --compression-level=9 --object-streams=generate' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh; ! grep -q 'qpdf --optimize' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh; grep -q 'command -v qpdf' benchmark/run_benchmark.sh

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given missing tool, When tool binary not found, Then script writes one row per tool per PDF with Output Size 'SKIPPED (not installed)' and Status 'SKIPPED (not installed)' rather than FAILED, and still produces pdfcompress rows.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given script completes, When ls is checked, Then benchmark_results_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.tsv exists in cwd and in build/ (copy), and script prints column -t -s $'\t' table, and never overwrites input PDFs (all outputs are <name>.<tool>.pdf alongside corpus).

tasks.title: Pure-C++ Render-Diff Helper Source — PDFium 150 DPI BGRA SSIM/PSNR
tasks.description: Create tools/render_diff.cpp that renders page 0 at 150 DPI via PDFium RAII and computes SSIM/PSNR in-process, no Python, N/A fallback on failure, parsable output.
acceptance_criteria: Given tools/render_diff.cpp, When inspected, Then it includes <fpdfview.h> or <public/fpdfview.h>, initializes via FPDF_InitLibraryWithConfig, loads docs via FPDF_LoadDocument, loads page 0 via FPDF_LoadPage(doc,0), computes width/height via FPDF_GetPageWidth/Height, creates BGRA bitmap w=pageWidthPt/72*150 h=pageHeightPt/72*150 via FPDFBitmap_Create, fills white 0xFFFFFFFF via FPDFBitmap_FillRect, renders via FPDF_RenderPageBitmap, retrieves buffers via FPDFBitmap_GetBuffer, and cleans via FPDFBitmap_Destroy/FPDF_ClosePage/FPDF_CloseDocument/FPDF_DestroyLibrary with RAII unique_ptr custom deleters.

Given two PDF paths argv[1] argv[2], When render succeeds for both, Then program computes SSIM (windowed mean/variance/covariance with C1=(0.01*255)^2 C2=(0.03*255)^2, 11x11 or 8x8 window) and PSNR (MSE -> 10*log10(255*255/MSE), INF if MSE==0) in C++ and prints parsable line e.g. 'SSIM 0.999 PSNR 42.1' or '0.999 42.1' or 'SSIM=0.999 PSNR=42.1' to stdout and exits 0.

Given either FPDF_LoadDocument fails (encrypted without password, missing file, bad PDF) or PDFium dylib unavailable at runtime, When program is invoked, Then it prints 'N/A N/A' to stdout (and optionally note to stderr) and exits 0, never crashes, never returns non-zero for this case.

Given tools/render_diff.cpp, When inspected, Then it contains no python3/pip/scikit-image/ImageMagick/compare references, is C++20, uses <cmath> <memory> <vector>, offline, and handles BGRA stride via FPDFBitmap_GetStride.
Given build environment, When compiled standalone, Then it builds clean with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic via pdfcompress_core or pdfium linkage, and C++ file is self-contained without requiring Python.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given tools/render_diff.cpp, When inspected, Then it includes <fpdfview.h> or <public/fpdfview.h>, initializes via FPDF_InitLibraryWithConfig, loads docs via FPDF_LoadDocument, loads page 0 via FPDF_LoadPage(doc,0), computes width/height via FPDF_GetPageWidth/Height, creates BGRA bitmap w=pageWidthPt/72*150 h=pageHeightPt/72*150 via FPDFBitmap_Create, fills white 0xFFFFFFFF via FPDFBitmap_FillRect, renders via FPDF_RenderPageBitmap, retrieves buffers via FPDFBitmap_GetBuffer, and cleans via FPDFBitmap_Destroy/FPDF_ClosePage/FPDF_CloseDocument/FPDF_DestroyLibrary with RAII unique_ptr custom deleters.
tests.expected_result: grep -q 'FPDF_InitLibraryWithConfig\|FPDF_InitLibrary' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDF_LoadDocument' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDF_LoadPage' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDF_GetPageWidth' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDFBitmap_Create' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDF_RenderPageBitmap' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'FPDFBitmap_GetBuffer' tools/render_diff.cpp; grep -q 'unique_ptr.*FPDF' tools/render_diff.cpp || grep -q 'FPDF_ClosePage' tools/render_diff.cpp

tasks.title: Render-Diff CMake Wiring + Benchmark TSV Integration (N/A fallback)
tasks.description: Wire tools/render_diff.cpp into CMakeLists.txt as render_diff binary linked against pdfcompress_core/pdfium and integrate benchmark/run_benchmark.sh to call render_diff per row with N/A fallback and header note.
acceptance_criteria: Given CMakeLists.txt, When inspected, Then it contains 'add_executable(render_diff tools/render_diff.cpp)' linked PRIVATE pdfcompress_core pdfium (or qpdf::libqpdf + pdfium) under if(BUILD_TESTING) or alongside diagnose, with target_compile_options -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic consistent, and render_diff binary builds via cmake --build.

Given benchmark/run_benchmark.sh after T02, When inspected after T04, Then it contains guarded invocation 'if [ -x "$BUILD_DIR/render_diff" ]; then SSIM/PSNR=$("$BUILD_DIR/render_diff" "$pdf" "$out_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A N/A") else SSIM=N/A PSNR=N/A; fi' or equivalent, parses two values, and fills TSV columns 7/8 per row.

Given render_diff unavailable (binary missing or PDFium load fails), When benchmark runs, Then TSV header contains note 'render-diff unavailable (PDFium C++ only)' or fallback sets SSIM=N/A PSNR=N/A for all rows and header notes fallback, never leaves columns empty.
